name: Mahou Shoujo Mion ~Mashou Jutai no Koku~
original_name: 魔法少女みおん～魔生受胎の刻～
source:
Mion returns to the fateful city to find her childhood friend and her own memories. But suddenly she is seized by the alien lifeform Zold, from that day onward begins a tempest of shame!

At last she makes the connection between Zold and her friend's disappearance. Enduring disgrace from all sides, she takes the ultimate stand!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118502.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Mion回到命运之城，寻找她儿时的朋友和自己的记忆。但突然她被外星生命体佐德抓住，从那天起，一场耻辱的风暴开始了！

最后，她将佐尔德和她朋友的失踪联系起来。忍受各方耻辱，她坚持到底！

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118502.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
